sources.title: Synthetic evaluation control: add-on therapy
sources.abstract: This synthetic randomized trial enrolled 180 adults with type 2 diabetes whose glucose was inadequately controlled on stable metformin. Participants continued metformin and received intervention A or placebo for 24 weeks. Mean HbA1c change from baseline was -0.8 percentage points in the intervention A add-on group and -0.3 percentage points in the placebo add-on group; the between-group difference was -0.5 percentage points. Fasting plasma glucose change was -24 mg/dL versus -6 mg/dL; the between-group difference was -18 mg/dL. This trial did not test intervention A monotherapy. Mortality was not measured. Effects beyond 24 weeks were not established.
